verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted open runtime that uses standard model sources (Hugging Face GGUF, Ollama). Its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs let clients move elsewhere, which lowers lock-in and indirectly supports leaving. However, no evidence shows an explicit export feature for chats, agents, users or usage data. Missing for 10: a documented data-export feature for chat history, agent configs and user data; a statement of the open formats used; independent or hands-on confirmation.
